stemMd: What happened to damaged woven containers according to the letter?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They were entered under furniture in every book.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They were always repaired with wood.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They were sent to an outside workshop in every case.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They were usually replaced without workshop repair.

explanationMd: The former curator describes routine replacement outside the workshop process, explaining why such damage need not appear in the workshop books.

distractorRationale.c: The letter describes replacement, not wooden repair.
distractorRationale.b: The letter refers to damaged containers.
